name: Heartstabber Mosquito
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 9. No listed languages.
appearance: An oversized mosquito with six long legs, glassy wings and a needlelike proboscis.

sections.Printed source:
James Wyatt, Plane Shift: Zendikar, first printing (April 2016), page 27. 
Uses Stirge from Monster Manual, first printing (September 2014), printed p. 284. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/17023-stirge
sections.Actions:
Blood Drain. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one creature. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage and attaches the mosquito to the target. The mosquito stops attacking while attached. At the start of each of its turns, the target instead loses 5 (1d4 + 3) HP from blood loss.
The mosquito can detach by spending 5 ft. of movement. It detaches in this way after draining 10 HP of blood or when the target dies. The target or another creature can spend its action detaching it.
sections.At the table: Track attached blood loss separately from the initial piercing hit. The target loses HP from Blood Drain without a new attack roll or save.

name: Oxen
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Passive Perception 11. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A heavy-shouldered draft ox with swept horns, a thick neck and broad cloven hooves.

sections.Printed source:
James Wyatt, Plane Shift: Zendikar, first printing (April 2016), page 34. 
Uses Giant Goat from Monster Manual, first printing (September 2014), printed p. 326. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16885-giant-goat
sections.Traits:
Charge. Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit it with Ram in the same turn. The target takes another 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit this way must pass a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone.
Sure-Footed. Roll Strength and Dexterity saves with advantage against effects that would knock the ox prone.
sections.Actions: Ram. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

name: Shoal Serpent
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +3 and Stealth +4. Passive Perception 13. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A massive marine serpent whose long neck rises above a heavy, reef-like back.

sections.Printed source:
James Wyatt, Plane Shift: Zendikar, first printing (April 2016), page 26. 
Uses Plesiosaurus from Monster Manual, first printing (September 2014), printed p. 80. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16981-plesiosaurus
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The serpent can stay on a single breath for 1 hour.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit with 10-ft. reach against one target. A hit deals 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.At the table: The printed base block retains 20 ft. of walking movement and 40 ft. of swimming movement.

name: Terastodon
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Passive Perception 10. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: An enormous armored elephant with four tusks and a sharp-edged bone plate extending from its head over the neck.

sections.Printed source:
James Wyatt, Plane Shift: Zendikar, first printing (April 2016), page 34. 
Uses Mammoth from Monster Manual, first printing (September 2014), printed p. 332. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16950-mammoth
sections.Traits: Trampling Charge. Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hit it with Gore that turn. The target makes a DC 18 Strength save or falls prone. If the target is prone, the terastodon may make one Stomp against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit with 10-ft. reach against one target. A hit deals 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage.
Stomp. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one prone creature. A hit deals 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
sections.At the table: Stomp has a 5-ft. reach, half of Gore’s 10-ft. reach. Check the distance before using a bonus-action Stomp.

name: Terra Stomper
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +4. Passive Perception 14. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A six-legged forest behemoth with massive jaws, a heavy tail and a low, thick-set body.

sections.Printed source:
James Wyatt, Plane Shift: Zendikar, first printing (April 2016), page 34. 
Uses Tyrannosaurus Rex from Monster Manual, first printing (September 2014), printed p. 80. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/17041-tyrannosaurus-rex
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail attack against different targets.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit with 10-ft. reach against one target. A hit deals 33 (4d12 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled and restrained until the grapple ends. The escape DC is 17. During the grapple, the stomper cannot bite another target.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit with 10-ft. reach against one target. A hit deals 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
